Subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint: Clearwave renewal & expansion

Hi Samantha / Carlos —

Kicking off our weekly MAP checkpoint for the Clearwave renewal and expansion. I pulled together a short status summary and proposed next steps so we stay on track for the 2026-06-30 renewal target and the expansion to the Clinical Insights team. High-level:

- Current renewal target: 2026-06-30 (contract end-date rollover)
- Expansion asks: add Clinical Insights team (approx. 15 licenses), +3 dedicated inference seats for batch ingestion, second retention tier for analytics add-on
- Adoption traction: production usage up ~35% MoM on the Evaluation cluster; goal is 2x usage by end of Q2 to justify additional seats

Immediate asks / agenda for this week’s sync (15 min):
1) Procurement timeline confirmation (Carlos) — where are we on PO / internal approvals?
2) Pricing consolidation (Rishi) — finalize the add-on pricing and seat discounts for expansion
3) Onboarding resources & timeline (Evelyn / Priyom) — dedicated onboarding days and metrics to measure success for the Clinical Insights team pilot
4) MAP spreadsheet update (attached) — owners + due dates

Action items I captured to date (please update if I missed anything):
- Rishi: finalize the quote and send to Carlos by 2026-03-06 (DocuSign link to follow)
- Carlos: confirm procurement date and internal approver list by 2026-03-09
- Evelyn: schedule onboarding kick-off for Clinical Insights pilot (target week of 2026-03-22)
- Priyom: provide technical onboarding checklist and required telemetry for success metrics by 2026-03-12

Attachments: MAP_v3.xlsx (current working MAP), usage_snapshot_Q1_2026.csv

If this looks right, can we confirm a standing 15-min weekly checkpoint every Wednesday at 9am PT? If not, propose an alternate slot.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

—
